verdict.rationale: The Drive REST API v3 covers the core UI operations: listing and searching files, three upload modes, file metadata and custom properties, sharing permissions with the full role set, change tracking and push notifications, plus a machine-readable discovery document. Hands-on rclone reports confirm that all content can be pulled out programmatically. However, no evidence establishes that the API matches everything the UI can do, and the standard OpenAPI and llms.txt paths return 404. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or coverage map, evidence for UI features such as OCR search, storage-sharing and plan management via the API, and a standard OpenAPI spec.
